The color of an eggplant is purple.

The cohesion of the approaching text is strong. The transitions and linking devices effectively guide the reader through the logical progression of ideas. The word "Moreover" adds supporting information to the initial claim about climate change being a global challenge. "Therefore" establishes a clear cause-and-effect relationship, indicating that the investment in renewable energy is a direct result of the need to reduce carbon emissions. Finally, the phrase "These efforts" serves as a cohesive device that refers back to the previous sentence, summarizing the actions taken and linking them to the ultimate goal of a sustainable future. This structure creates a smooth and logical flow.
